wheel: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent foreground wheel layer for a real automotive website, to be rotated over separate stationary brake components. Create a premium PHOTOREALISTIC studio product photograph of ONE car wheel, dead straight front orthographic view, perfectly circular and centered, square canvas. Black rubber tyre with realistic subtle tread and sidewall texture, polished gunmetal ten-spoke alloy rim (five split pairs), metallic chamfers, small blank circular central hub with five lug bolts. The open gaps between all spokes must be genuinely TRANSPARENT, so separate brake disc and caliper layers can show through. Outside the tyre also fully transparent. Wheel diameter 90 percent of canvas, circle center exactly canvas center. Symmetric neutral studio light from directly in front, accurate realistic metal, high detail. No brake disc, no caliper, no suspension, no scenery, no cast shadow outside tyre, no car, no typography, no logos, no watermark. This is the tyre and rim foreground ONLY, not a complete assembled wheel with dark filled gaps. Transparent cutout alpha everywhere between spokes.
caliper: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent car brake caliper layer behind an alloy wheel. Photorealistic studio product cutout of ONE premium yellow brake caliper seen straight from the OUTSIDE FACE of a wheel, orthographic front view. Tall narrow curved rectangular sculpted cast-metal body, vertical orientation following the right side of a circular brake disc, bright muted golden yellow ceramic paint, real bevels, seam, two subtle dark fasteners and brake pad edges. It is to sit behind wheel spokes. Object occupies central 45 percent of square canvas width and 85 percent height. Soft neutral studio illumination, real photographic metal details. Fully transparent background. No wheel, no brake disc, no words, no branding, no watermarks, no external shadow, no scenery. No perspective tilt.

wheelNeutralV3.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: transparent rotating tyre-and-rim foreground for an existing automotive website. Input Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY the baked lighting and reflectivity of this exact wheel. Preserve the same black rubber tyre, tread geometry, split ten-spoke alloy rim, lug bolts, dimensions, front orthographic camera, centered circular silhouette and transparent outside and spoke openings. Remove the broad top-versus-bottom / left-versus-right brightness difference on the tyre; make rubber uniformly charcoal with softly visible tread texture. Remove sharp directional specular bands and white hotspots from the metal spokes and central hub. Make the metal a medium gunmetal satin finish lit by very broad, uniform coaxial diffuse illumination, so every repeated spoke has equal brightness. Small local bevel and cavity shading may remain, but no single off-axis light source, no directional brushed swirl on the center hub, no bright upper edge, no luminous streaks. Intended use: the wheel image rotates while a separate stationary lighting overlay will supply highlights, so this is a neutral material/base-color layer with minimal baked highlights. Keep the photographic material detail and exact existing design. Keep all spoke gaps genuinely fully transparent, no brake disc or caliper; preserve alpha transparency. No text, logos, added objects, floor or background.

brakeDiscPhotographicV4.prompt: Use case: product-mockup / real studio photography. Asset type: a transparent brake rotor photograph to sit behind a rotating car wheel on a dark automotive website. Create ONE realistic high-performance two-piece drilled brake disc, perfectly straight front-on orthographic view, perfectly circular and exactly centred on a square canvas with 5% transparent padding. This is a real machined metal product photograph, with fine concentric machining wear and subtle steel grain, a medium smoky silver cast-iron friction ring (not flat white, not plastic), dark graphite aluminium central hat and believable small recessed mounting fasteners. Several restrained concentric rows of small drilled holes through the friction ring, genuinely transparent holes, and a transparent central axle bore. Broad even frontal softbox lighting gives photographic chamfers and metal depth without a single bright directional hotspot. Symmetric lighting suitable for rotating as a 2D photograph. Transparent alpha outside the disc, inside the axle bore and through the drilled holes. No wheel, tyre, caliper, brake pad, scenery, floor, external drop shadow, text, logo or watermark. No diagram, no cartoon, no toy, no Lego, no flat vector look, no simplified computer model. The ring should look metallic and slightly used, like a close-up DSLR photo of a real sports-car brake rotor.
